facts.finding: Records.System controls the visible module; an append-only department cutover separately determines RecordsUsable and legacy write blocking. Existing activation must be verified read-only, not repeated. Activation changes permission mappings; it is outside this capture replay.

Normal definition management needs the controller RecordDefinition_Update policy plus service ManageRecordDefinitions. Publishing additionally requires RecordDefinition_Publish / PublishRecordDefinitions. Record authoring and finalization have separate policies, active-member checks and per-record visibility/authority. Current UI controls are authoritative; do not grant rights for the lesson.

Records sidebar exposes dashboard and All records. On the queue, Manage contains Definitions when permitted. The definitions catalog offers Browse templates, New definition and per-published-row New Record; use that row link to avoid the generic New action defaulting to locked Training.

A new department key is normalized and must be unique, start with a lower-case letter, use lower-case letters/digits/dots/dashes and avoid system. Blank creation produces draft v1 with required ShortText Summary and optional LongText Notes. It does not publish a catalog entry or create an operational record.

The controlled designer exposes policy fields and Schema (JSON), plus a read-only field table. Validate runs validation without persisting. Save draft persists and redirects to a fresh version page. Publish impact is a separate preview; Publish is a normal POST preceded by a native JavaScript confirm. Published versions become read-only and new records use the published version.

Current Core form can select Responder/Unit/IC/Dispatch, Allow offline, Allow attachments and photo-coordinate retention. Its model constructs a fresh ClientSurface from those booleans; it has no LaunchContexts or MinimumAppVersion fields. The model default LaunchContexts is empty and the field catalog interprets empty as none. Therefore a new blank definition can target an empty/global context via normal UI, but an arbitrary call/unit context cannot be promised through an unseen setting. Do not edit an existing template surface to work around this limitation.

Field catalog requires a supported origin, Records module usable, that app's field flag, active membership and its configured minimum version; individual definitions also require surface/context/capability/min-version eligibility. CreateRecord refusal yields a read-only/empty catalog, while listing failure reports catalog_unavailable. A list screen is not proof that New Record or a definition is eligible.

Server verifies each supplied context identifier. A Unit-origin request with UnitId is rejected as context_not_verified unless the authenticated user is in the last unit state Roles crew. An empty context is permitted; a call must belong to the department and be viewable. Do not change crew or forge context to bypass this boundary.

The earlier Unit exercise used Boden with Engine51 while only Herrmann occupied its configured seat. That combination is consistent with the crew-context rejection above. This source trace does not prove which runtime branch produced that historical banner; no log/SQL/browser trace was performed.

Responder's normal Records context is its active call when set, otherwise an empty object. Quick Create renders only after the field status is enabled and catalog Definitions is nonempty. A published new definition enabled for Responder with default none context should be tested from an actually empty active-call context; a current call can legitimately exclude it. Source does not establish runtime success.

Save draft and successful fresh edit/details readback are distinct from finalization. QuickEntry transitions Draft to Finalized; ReviewRequired and ApprovalAcknowledgement require other lifecycle states. Generic Core Records MVC exposes Finalize, not SubmitForReview/Approve controls. Finalize checks state, row version, definition role/authority, revealed data and required fields, allocates a number if needed and writes an immutable revision/outbox event. No provider delivery or review outcome is implied.

Add attachment on Details is offered for an editable non-terminal record; it posts files with explicit classification. Once finalized, attachments require an amendment. Use a tiny public software TXT, not incident media or device photos. A filename after fresh readback is stored attachment evidence; a selected chooser file is preparation only.

Source discrepancy: Create/EditDefinition upload options label value1 Unrestricted and value2 Restricted, while enum values are 0 Unrestricted, 1 Restricted, 2 Protected. Details AddAttachment correctly offers value1 Restricted and value0 Unrestricted. For this replay, first save without files, then use Details' visible Unrestricted operational content choice; do not claim Create/Edit upload classification is correct or change code.

Protected write handling is independent of the record's Standard label. The write seam allows a write when encryption is not required; when protection is enforced and nonempty fields need encryption, attended callers require a valid normal grant. Protection-state errors fail closed. Existing reveal/step-up gates must be honored; no policy, MFA, auth, role, grant or hidden API changes belong to the exercise.

Queue filtering by definition/state/year is distinct from full text search. When the search host is unavailable, q is reported not applied rather than silently treated as a database search. CSV/JSON/print/PDF permissions and their result are separate; PDF/import/provider submissions remain deferred and no successful output is claimed.
